note.after_visit_summary: You have trouble staying asleep, which we call moderate insomnia. We checked you today: blood pressure and heart rate were fine, and you are awake and thinking clearly. We are not restarting your old sleep pill, trazodone, because it made you dizzy. You can stop the Benadryl you take at night; even though it is sold over the counter, it can cause confusion and falls at your age. You may keep melatonin, but take only 3 mg once an hour before bed. We are setting up a 6-session class on sleep therapy and will send a sleep diary to your portal. To help your sleep: get up at 6:30 AM every day, do not watch TV in bed, take a morning walk outside, limit naps to 20 minutes before 2 PM, and stop coffee after noon. Come back in 6 weeks. Call us sooner if you feel confused or if you fall.
